scope: Capture existing approved close/middle/wide presets in an original saved area with actual matching keyed and primary camera/rotation, measured keyed FOV and actual VMI_LIT. No Content authoring/compile/save/residency force.
validated_checks: Exact sole actual PID, current original-map identity, assignment SHA and root authoring lease; paused/HDAautooff/autosaveoff/callback safeguards and twelve sealed modules.
All seventeen original Epic material/texture file hashes explicitly equal the pinned native inspection before camera setters and remain exact afterward.

Full 1015-node h.describe snapshot including Custom code/input/output and sampler mip fields is compared before/after; all six blend nodes retain the pinned complete structures of 69 unique layer names; material output roots remain exact across capture.

All three MI states, scene/runtime sources, original maps/base/Grass/master/child/Epic files and held-copy file state are captured unchanged before/after. Dirty maps must be empty and content a subset of master/current-child/held copy.
Existing camera-file SHA, exact presets, unique stage/shot image and receipt paths, finite camera comparisons, active-key identity and actual Lit readback guard the asynchronous screenshot request.
limitations: Fixed 1015-node count intentionally fails closed if a later Epic integration appends nodes. Such an integration needs a separately reviewed capture fork bound to the actual approved new graph identity/count.

Camera/viewmode UI presentation changes are authorized; primary FOV is unexposed and reported unknown. No registered-streamer-camera update or ordinary mip readiness is established by the screenshot request.
PNG completion, actual image dimensions/visual review and default fresh-process appearance must be independently measured by the writer. A valid screenshot task is not visual approval.
The existing 37c2806a capture remains historical with scene/MI/file preservation only; this review applies exclusively to e574fef8 frozen bytes.
